title: Tactical Intercom & Radio Simulation System
summary: Integrated voice communication system simulating tactical radio channels, intercom hot-mics, frequency modulation, and radio propagation noise.
highlights: Simulated UHF/VHF military radio networks with line-of-sight attenuation and frequency selection.
Low-latency VoIP streaming with push-to-talk (PTT) hardware switch integration.
Multi-crew cockpit intercom with selectable voice isolation modes.
